block_invariants.Q_s: Hafnian of the four endpoints selected by s

cross_colour_polarization: A literal 4+4 breaker with colour c on orientation s and d on its complement has core Q_s(M^c)Q_complement(s)(M^d), not b_s(M^c). Recovering the eight self terms from these cross terms and their tails is the missing source-global lemma.
identity_1: sum_[s modulo complement] b_s = D + P01*P23+P02*P13+P03*P12
identity_2: Z = sum_{|S|=3} t_S + sum_[s modulo complement] b_s - (e01*e23+e02*e13+e03*e12)
normalization: the four selected same-colour M0 anchors equal 1
scope: This is a polynomial identity in 24 independent block entries and an exact source-tail decomposition. It is not yet a unit certificate for the full normalized ideal.
source_residual_formula: Writing each literal mixed row as H_e=e+tau_e and H_t=t+tau_t, on V(I_mix) identity_2 gives Z=-sum tau_t + sum b_self - sum tau_e*tau_e_complement. The tail provenance below is literal.
variables: six arbitrary oriented 2x2 blocks M_ij (24 entries)
